_note: Home Assistant documentation/config repo. 'App source' here means MCP config mutations and dashboard YAML — changes to those are what trigger the docs contract. source_patterns are best-effort globs; tighten them against the actual repo layout after install. Default branch is master (protected first), main protected defensively.

G1.name: Docs Quality
G1.desc: Markdown lint clean across the repo. PASS = make lint-md exits 0.

G2.name: Alignment
G2.desc: Change matches the request: complete, no scope creep, documentation reflects what is actually deployed (no aspirational docs).

G3.name: Runtime Verification
G3.desc: Dashboard YAML and MCP config changes verified against the live Home Assistant instance where applicable: entities exist, dashboards render, MCP servers still respond.
